Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 23 Marrickville Station West Precinct 23.pdf

Clause 9.23.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.23.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identified values of the Civic Precinct H eritage C onservation A rea.

Clause 9.23.2 - height_limit (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes within the precinct.

Clause 9.23.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure that the provision and location of off -street car parking does not adversely impact the amenity of the precinct.

Clause 9.23.2 - other (development_control): To ensure orderly development on masterplan sites in accordance with the principles of the masterplan vision, in cluding allotment amalgamations, where required, that are not detrimental to achieving th e overall masterplan structure  and achieve  an efficient and high quality built outcome.

Clause 9.23.2 - other (land_use_zoning): To encourage compl ementary medium density and residential flat building develop ment in the Ann Street and Arthur Street area.

Clause 9.23.2 - other (land_use_zoning): To promote high density redevelopment on t he land bounded by Arthur Street and the rail corridor.

Clause 9.23.2 - other (land_use_zoning): To accommodate new residential flat building development to reflect the existing developmen t at the western end  of the precinct bounded by Livingstone Road, Arthur Street and the rail corridor.
